This is a successor **proposal for Codex/GPT agreement**, not an accepted implementation contract. No runtime work starts from this response.

I inspected the published map/status at `a78afc3896d5c0c5c6e2edba485f410593777226`, the pre-Unity contract, OMA acceptance and exclusions, relevant earlier contracts/reviews, and selected runtime/console paths. I also matched 17 relevant archived source files against the published engine Git blobs. **I ran no builds, gameplay, qualification or benchmarks and changed no repository files.**

The next module addresses a concrete player-facing gap. `ConnectedExpeditionSession` exposes the existing work starts but omits mining pause/resume, research pause/cancel, manufacturing pause/resume/cancel and the water-fill lifecycle. Its console query/discovery entry points still route through the casting-named interface. The work view omits water filling. Those findings agree with OMA’s explicitly retained host limitation. See [session implementation](https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/a78afc3896d5c0c5c6e2edba485f410593777226/engine/com.decennium.foundation/Laboratory/Model/ConnectedExpeditionSession.cs) and [OMA capability ledger](https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/a78afc3896d5c0c5c6e2edba485f410593777226/docs/unity/evidence/2026-11-23-tac01-ordinary-magic/UNRESOLVED_CAPABILITIES.json).

**Why this comes next**

The approved operational sequence ends at accepted OMA116; it does not mandate a particular successor. This recommendation extends that sequence with a required gameplay/host integration gap whose underlying procedures already exist.

It advances MGT-02-C1/C2, INT-05-C1/C2 and UR-07, with bounded contributions to the work, resource and persistence interactions in CI-02/03/06/07/10. It does not close those entire obligations. The [pre-Unity completion contract](https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/a78afc3896d5c0c5c6e2edba485f410593777226/docs/unity/PRE_UNITY_COMPLETION_CONTRACT.md) requires usable authoritative operations and explanations, not merely internal handlers.

**Included scope**

Use the existing actors, credentials, known sources, sites, tools, finite stock and procedure records. Admit these operations through the normal connected session:

| Family | Included operations | Preserved semantic distinction |
|---|---|---|
| Ordinary water filling | `StartWaterFill`, `PauseWaterFill`, `ResumeWaterFill`, `CancelWaterFill` | Two usable hands; 60 active seconds; fixed source/destination/amount; transfer only at completion. Pause retains progress and reservations; cancellation releases them without liquid transfer. |
| Existing exposed-node mining | `StartMining`, `PauseMining`, `ResumeMining` | Preserve selected finite claim, commitment boundary, feasible progress, actual tools and once-only resolution. **Do not invent `CancelMining`.** |
| Connected recipe-4 research | `StartFormulaResearch`, `PauseFormulaWork`, `ResumeFormulaWork`, `CancelFormulaWork` | Preserve actual knowledge acquisition, retained feasible labor, work windows and `AwaitingCheck`. Cancellation transfers no labor into another attempt. |
| Connected recipe-4 manufacturing | `StartManufacturing`, `PauseManufacturing`, `ResumeManufacturing`, `CancelManufacturing` | Preserve completed phases, unfinished-phase loss, ingredient age/stabilization and exact cancellation settlement. The existing one-order restriction includes terminal cancellation. |

Reuse `ResolveManufacturingQuality` and its accepted explanation as the existing pending continuation; add no new quality mechanics.

Provide a coherent seat-authorized work query/discovery surface, console dispatch and immutable work views showing actual status, earned/retained work, reservations and available controls. Final API names are for the contract, but they must use the same assessments as execution.

Relevant implementation seams are:

- `ConnectedExpeditionSession.cs`, `ConnectedExpeditionView.cs`, `Open-ConnectedExpedition.ps1`;
- `SharedWorldCommandQueries.cs`, `SharedWorldRangedCombat.cs`;
- `TestOnlyFillingPolicy.cs`, `WaterFilling.cs`;
- `SharedMining.cs`, `SharedFormulaResearch.cs`, `SharedConnectedFormulaResearch.cs`, `SharedManufacturing.cs`;
- existing `Simulation`, `WorkLedger`, `ActiveWorkProgress`, receipts and verified restoration.

No second scheduler, resource ledger, clock or RNG is warranted.

The source contract must pin Expedition FL-01–05 and EC-02/03, the exact mining and crafting procedures, and these adopted policies: [water filling](https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/a78afc3896d5c0c5c6e2edba485f410593777226/docs/unity/VESSEL_FILLING_RULE_DECISIONS.md), [formula research](https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/a78afc3896d5c0c5c6e2edba485f410593777226/docs/unity/FORMULA_RESEARCH_RULE_DECISIONS.md), [mining](https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/a78afc3896d5c0c5c6e2edba485f410593777226/docs/unity/MINING_RULE_DECISIONS.md), and the [accepted connected batch contract](https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/a78afc3896d5c0c5c6e2edba485f410593777226/docs/unity/evidence/2026-11-12-mgt04-connected-recipe4-batch/IMPLEMENTATION_CONTRACT.md).

**Decisions required before coding**

| Gate | Required disposition |
|---|---|
| **WC-01 — Selection and compatibility** | Define the opt-in successor composition and fingerprint. Check identifier availability; do not assume profile117 or a new wire format. Preserve profiles95–116 and their existing host behavior. |
| **WC-02 — Authority and discovery** | Exact actor/job/source/target permissions for every operation and view. Distinguish control of a worker from permission over stock. Define deterministic discovery and parameterized quantity choices without exposing hidden inventory. |
| **WC-03 — Lifecycle semantics** | Bind every supported status/control transition, including zero versus positive labor, manufacturing phase loss, terminal cancellation and `AwaitingCheck`. Do not impose a universal cancellation/refund rule. |
| **WC-04 — Timing and context** | Define admissible stages, active/paused work, traversal, conditions, pending choices and encounter boundaries using existing rules. Water filling’s unsupported tactical/transition cases remain explicit unless separately reviewed. |
| **WC-05 — Persistence and evidence** | Specify authoritative records, causal validation, compatibility and genuine route branches. Confirm the evidence fits existing history capacities; no silent cap increase or fabricated replenishment. |

The contract must specifically handle “resume” at `AwaitingCheck`: it can resolve an existing due check rather than book more labor. Querying that possibility must neither draw RNG nor predict the eventual result.

**Finite proposed acceptance criteria**

1. **WC-A1 — Accepted contract.** Close WC-01–05 with source bindings, exact operation matrix, independently derived expectations and actual GPT/Codex agreement before implementation.
2. **WC-A2 — Complete host coverage.** Every included operation works through session and console interfaces, with matching query/discovery and work views. No reflection or privileged `Simulation` bypass substitutes for a host witness.
3. **WC-A3 — Genuine connected play.** From lawful fresh genesis, demonstrate mining, research, manufacture and subsequent useful output, plus real filling and ordinary continuation. Cancellation branches may share genuine parent checkpoints; they must remain distinct from the successful one-order manufacturing route.
4. **WC-A4 — Native lifecycle boundaries.** Demonstrate each family’s pause/resume behavior; actual cancellation where supported; once-only completion; and relevant commitment, phase, work-window and pending-check boundaries.
5. **WC-A5 — Cross-system interaction.** Show compatible worker progress while another controlled actor acts; reject incompatible same-actor work. Include actual active-fill magic denial, paused-fill lawful magic and resumption, preserving OMA accounting. Make no claim that every work family can run in combat.
6. **WC-A6 — Conservation and RNG.** Account for source stock, capacity, custody, claims, consumed/returned ingredients, outputs and knowledge. Reads and rejected commands change nothing; accepted check resolution owns the exact draws once.
7. **WC-A7 — Authority and privacy.** Cover wrong/revoked seats, wrong worker/job, inaccessible or reserved resources, stale/conflicting requests, persisted retries and capacity rejection. Diagnostics and discovery expose only authorized information.
8. **WC-A8 — Persistence.** Strict restore and continue active, paused and supported pending states; reject checksum-valid causal forgeries; recover backup; preserve the existing compatibility matrix and add authentic116 continuation.
9. **WC-A9 — Complete path evidence.** Five full console/typed/restored/replay modes for the agreed principal route, with canonical state, RNG, filtered views and ordered discovery comparisons. Separate branch evidence covers cancellations and distinct native outcomes.
10. **WC-A10 — Frozen final review.** Retain exact source/build/host identities, C#9 warnings-as-errors, package checks, all1,592 predecessor cases plus meaningful additions, actual terminal results and failures/corrections. Obtain actual final module review and Codex concurrence.

General recruitment, autonomous scheduling, started-work reassignment, new recipes/deposits, formula copying, general equipment release, tactical filling, arbitrary sites and new interruption policies are excluded. In particular, the Hero’s held-Club limitation cannot be bypassed to manufacture a witness. Those mandatory broader capabilities remain open.

Archive or reconcile that superseded record and clearly distinguish historical stop wording from the active goal. **This is a status correction, not an OMA acceptance defect.**

Please return the concrete definition and WC-01–05 contract for agreement. This recommendation grants no successor runtime acceptance, whole-workstream closure, performance qualification, production authority or Unity authorization.
